review_notes: Every s### and t### appears in exactly one unit; no added or unrepresented units are needed, since each English token answers to a source token.

The two chief judgment calls are ὑπέρ → *more than* headed on *more* (rule 17's meaning-bearing word over the formal prepositional *than*) and πόσῳ → *how much* headed on *much* under rule 104's degree-correlative clause.
Both anarthrous datives σαρκί and κυρίῳ take their supplied *the* as rule 51 helpers; no article stands in the projection to claim it.
